AddMemories.description_en: Extracts memories from text or messages, or directly writes organized memories. When the extract parameter is omitted or set to true, either the text parameter or non-empty messages must be provided. When the extract parameter is set to false, the memories parameter is used. When the sync parameter is omitted or set to true, the operation waits for processing to complete and returns memory references. An empty array is returned if no new memories are generated. When the sync parameter is set to false, a task ID is returned, and you can use GetMemoryTask to query the result. Direct writes do not create extraction tasks
AddMemories.description_zh: 支持从文本或消息中提取记忆，也支持直接写入整理好的记忆。extract 省略或为 true 时，text 与非空 messages 二选一；extract=false 时使用 memories。sync 省略或为 true 时等待处理完成并返回记忆引用，未产生新记忆时可返回空数组；sync=false 时返回任务标识，使用 GetMemoryTask 查询结果。直接写入不创建抽取任务

BatchDeleteModels.description_en: Deletes models from a specified workspace in batches. If any model is in use, the entire batch request fails
BatchDeleteModels.description_zh: 批量删除指定工作空间中的模型；任一模型正在被使用时，整批请求失败

BatchUploadSkillsViaOss.description_en: Uploads multiple skill ZIP packages through OSS and returns the processing result for each skill
BatchUploadSkillsViaOss.description_zh: 通过 OSS 中转批量上传 Skill ZIP 包，并返回每个 Skill 的处理结果

BeginAssetUpload.description_en: 申请知识库资产上传地址
BeginAssetUpload.description_zh: 登记资产上传会话，返回 assetId、uploadId 和实际状态；仅有效的 UPLOADING 会话返回限定其 original 对象的限时 PUT 地址。使用 PUT 上传文件二进制，不使用 JSON 或 multipart 包装，本期文件大小为 1 字节至 50 MiB。clientToken 可选；提供时，省略 assetId 将依据租户、工作空间、知识库和 clientToken 稳定派生资产 ID，便于首次响应丢失后的定位。同时省略 assetId 和 clientToken 时，每次请求创建新资产。未提供 clientToken 时按新的上传意图处理，不保证跨请求重试幂等。覆盖已有资产必须设置 overwrite=true；该参数仅授权覆盖，不强制重新导入。提供 clientToken 时，仅对该资产最近一次 Begin 保存的 token 幂等；后续 Begin（包括省略 clientToken 的请求）会替换最近请求标识。命中且规范化请求相同则复用上传会话，参数不同返回 409，包括 sourceETag 不同；token 不命中则按新的上传意图校验和受理，即使该 token 曾用于更早的上传。来源版本去重独立于 clientToken：指定稳定 assetId、overwrite=true 且提供 sourceETag 时，若来源身份及版本、导入参数和有效处理配置均未变化，即使未提供 clientToken，也可复用当前 uploadId 和加工代次；显式提供且命中最近 token 时仍要求完整规范化请求相同。复用有效 UPLOADING 会话时刷新同一对象路径的签名；复用 PENDING、PROCESSING 或 COMPLETED 会话时返回实际状态且不返回上传地址，PENDING 按相同 taskKey 补交调度，来源版本相同不表示处理完成。客户端 token 幂等命中后的失败状态只返回当前状态；新的上传意图遇到 FAILED、上传意图过期或来源、导入参数、有效处理配置变化时创建新的 uploadId、内部对象路径及加工代次。未提供 sourceETag 时不启用来源版本去重，可使用不同 clientToken 或不提供 clientToken，按新的上传意图重新导入；覆盖已有资产仍须 overwrite=true。新结果发布前仍使用旧发布版本。每个会话的原件对象仍必须禁止覆盖，签名头通过 headers 返回。完成 PUT 上传后，使用返回的 assetId 和 uploadId 调用 CompleteAssetUpload。携带 sourceETag 的 Begin 命中当前上传目标时，PENDING 会按相同 taskKey 补交调度，返回 PENDING、PROCESSING 或 COMPLETED 后无需再次上传或确认；显式提供相同 clientToken 且未传 sourceETag 的 PENDING 重放仍须重试 CompleteAssetUpload，以恢复受理结果未知的调度

CompleteAssetUpload.description_en: Confirms a specified upload session by using the workspaceId, knowledgeBaseId, and assetId in the path and the uploadId in the request body. The server verifies tenant and resource ownership, requires the uploadId to match the current upload session and the upload_epoch to equal the current next_epoch, and then performs a HEAD operation on the bound original object to verify its existence, actual size of 1 byte to 50 MiB, and content type. Using the metadata and chunking configuration saved during acceptance, the server enters the pending state through a CAS operation that includes the upload identity, target generation, UPLOADING status, and deletion marker. Repeatedly confirming the same accepted upload that is still the current target returns the existing status without incrementing the generation or creating a new task. If the scheduling acceptance result is unknown, the server resubmits the task by using the same taskKey. When a subsequent overwrite upload, edit, or rebuild replaces the target, a delayed Complete request returns a status conflict and does not overwrite the new task or resurrect deleted assets. Non-retryable processing failures remain in the FAILED state and are not requeued by the Complete request
CompleteAssetUpload.description_zh: 通过路径中的 workspaceId、knowledgeBaseId、assetId 和请求体中的 uploadId 确认指定上传会话。服务端校验租户和资源归属，要求 uploadId 匹配当前上传会话，且 upload_epoch 与当前 next_epoch 相等，再对绑定的 original 对象执行 HEAD，核验存在性、实际大小为 1 字节至 50 MiB 及内容类型。使用受理时保存的元数据和分块配置，通过包含上传身份、目标代次、UPLOADING 状态和删除标记的 CAS 进入待处理状态。重复确认同一已受理且仍为当前目标的上传返回已有状态，不递增代次或创建新任务；调度受理结果未知时按相同 taskKey 补交。后续覆盖上传、编辑或重建已替换目标时，迟到的 Complete 返回状态冲突，不得覆盖新任务或复活删除资产。不可重试的处理失败保持 FAILED，不由 Complete 重新入队

ConvertMcpToFreeEdit.description_en: Converts an MCP service to free-edit mode
ConvertMcpToFreeEdit.description_zh: 将 MCP 转为自由编辑

CreateAgentIMChannel.description_en: Creates an instant messaging (IM) channel for a specified agent and binds a publicly accessible ServiceEndpoint
CreateAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 为指定智能体创建 IM 渠道，并绑定可公开访问的 ServiceEndpoint

CreateAgentSpec.description_en: Creates an AgentSpec in a specified workspace and generates the first draft version. Returns a resource conflict error if an AgentSpec with the same name already exists
CreateAgentSpec.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建 AgentSpec，并生成首个草稿版本。同名 AgentSpec 已存在时返回资源冲突错误

CreateAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Creates a new draft version for an existing AgentSpec. The AgentSpec must exist and cannot have a draft currently being edited
CreateAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 为已有 AgentSpec 创建新的草稿版本。AgentSpec 必须存在，且当前不能有正在编辑的草稿

CreateCredential.description_en: Creates an apiKey or mcpHeader credential in a workspace for agents or MCP to access external services. The credential content is submitted as a JSON string, and masked results are returned when queried
CreateCredential.description_zh: 在工作空间中创建 apiKey 或 mcpHeader 凭证，供智能体或 MCP 访问外部服务。凭证内容使用 JSON 字符串提交，查询时返回脱敏结果

CreateCustomAgent.description_en: Creates a custom code or image agent in a specified workspace. Supports code package, ACR image, and custom image deployments, and executes the deployment asynchronously
CreateCustomAgent.description_zh: 在指定工作空间创建自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent，支持代码包、ACR 镜像和自定义镜像部署，并异步执行部署

CreateCustomAgentDebugToken.description_en: Issues a local debugging token for a running high-code agent in a specified workspace. The latest configuration of the agent must be in effect. The workspace must have inbound access enabled for the selected network and debug routing configured. The token is valid for 1 hour from the time of issuance. After the token expires, you can call this operation again to obtain a new one
CreateCustomAgentDebugToken.description_zh: 为指定工作空间中已运行的高代码智能体签发本地调试令牌。智能体的最新配置须已生效，工作空间须已开启所选网络的入站访问并完成调试路由准备。令牌自签发起 1 小时内有效，过期后可重新调用本接口获取

CreateEvents.description_en: Writes messages, summaries, or session fork events in batches. Each batch supports 1 to 100 events and returns the write result for each event in the same order as the request. A successful request does not indicate that every event is written successfully or that memory extraction is complete. The session title and metadata are set only when the session is created for the first time. Subsequent writes do not update existing session information
CreateEvents.description_zh: 批量写入消息、摘要或会话分支事件。每批支持 1～100 条，逐条返回写入结果，顺序与请求一致。请求成功不表示每条事件均写入成功，也不表示记忆提取已经完成。session 仅在首次创建会话时设置标题和元数据，后续写入不更新已有会话信息

CreateExternalAgent.description_en: Creates an agent that runs in an external environment, saves the configurations for the platform model, instructions, tools, and skills, and asynchronously processes the onboarding configuration
CreateExternalAgent.description_zh: 创建由外部环境运行的智能体，保存平台模型、指令、工具和技能配置，并异步处理接入配置

CreateExternalAgentBootstrapToken.description_en: Issues an access token for a specified network to an active managed agent and returns the CMS configuration
CreateExternalAgentBootstrapToken.description_zh: 为已生效的纳管 Agent签发指定网络的接入令牌，并返回 CMS 配置

CreateIdentityProvider.description_en: Integrates an external identity provider such as DingTalk, Lark, or a custom identity source into a workspace for enterprise account logon and user synchronization
CreateIdentityProvider.description_zh: 为工作空间接入钉钉、飞书或自定义身份源，用于企业账号登录和用户同步

CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredential.description_en: Issues a SCIM credential explicitly and returns the plaintext token only in the current response. A maximum of two credentials are allowed per pool. This operation does not automatically revoke old credentials or enable AgentCore user synchronization
CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredential.description_zh: 显式签发一枚 SCIM 凭据并仅当次返回 Token 明文。同池最多两枚，不自动撤销旧凭据或开启 AC 用户同步

CreateIdentityProviderSyncJob.description_en: Initiates a manual synchronization of an identity provider

CreateImageCache.description_en: Creates or reuses an image cache for ACR Enterprise Edition images in a workspace, and returns the cache status upon acceptance
CreateImageCache.description_zh: 为工作空间的 ACR 企业版镜像创建或复用缓存，并返回受理时的缓存状态

CreateKnowledgeBase.description_en: Creates a knowledge base in a specified workspace of the current tenant, and persistently binds the trusted tenantId and workspaceId. The creation process is asynchronous, and the response returns the resource status. You can query the status and lastError by calling GetKnowledgeBase or ListKnowledgeBases
CreateKnowledgeBase.description_zh: 在当前租户的指定工作空间中创建知识库，持久化绑定可信 tenantId 和 workspaceId。创建为异步过程，响应返回资源状态；通过 GetKnowledgeBase 或 ListKnowledgeBases 查询 status 和 lastError

CreateManagedAgent.description_en: Creates a managed Harness agent in a specified workspace, configures the harness, model, skills, and runtime resources, and deploys it asynchronously
CreateManagedAgent.description_zh: 在指定工作空间创建托管 Harness Agent，配置 Harness、模型、技能及运行资源，并异步部署

CreateMcp.description_en: Creates an MCP service in a specified workspace. The creation process is asynchronous. You can check the returned status or call the query operation to confirm whether the service is ready
CreateMcp.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建 MCP 服务。创建为异步过程，可通过返回的状态或查询接口确认服务是否就绪

CreateMemoryRule.description_en: Creates an extraction rule for a memory store, specifying the rule name, enabling status, and extraction strategy. After the rule is enabled, extraction is triggered when 8 pending extraction events accumulate in a session or when no new pending extraction events are added for 60 consecutive seconds
CreateMemoryRule.description_zh: 为记忆库创建抽取规则，指定规则名称、启用状态和抽取策略。规则启用后，会话中累计 8 条待提取事件或连续 60 秒没有新增待提取事件时触发抽取

CreateMemoryStore.description_en: Creates a long-term memory store in a specified workspace
CreateMemoryStore.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建长期记忆库

CreateModel.description_en: Creates a model configuration under a model connection in a specified workspace for model creation
CreateModel.description_zh: 在指定工作空间的模型连接下创建模型配置

CreateModelConnection.description_en: Creates a model connection in a specified workspace and configures the upstream model service endpoint, invoke protocol, and access credentials for model creation
CreateModelConnection.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建模型连接，并配置上游模型服务地址、调用协议和访问凭据

CreateSkillDraft.description_en: Creates a skill in a specified workspace and generates an editable draft version. You can derive the draft from an existing version, or specify a target version and a commit message
CreateSkillDraft.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建 Skill，并生成可继续编辑的草稿版本。可以基于已有版本派生草稿，也可以指定目标版本和提交说明

CreateTeam.description_en: Creates a team in a specified workspace and configures user members and agent members at the same time. The user members must include exactly one member with the ADMIN role, and agent members can only have the LEADER or WORKER role
CreateTeam.description_zh: 在指定工作空间内创建团队，并同时设置用户成员和智能体成员。用户成员中必须且只能有一个角色为 ADMIN 的成员，智能体成员的角色只能是 LEADER 或 WORKER

CreateUser.description_en: Creates a user in a specified workspace. The username must be unique within the workspace, can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, and cannot be a reserved name such as manager, admin, or any name starting with worker-. If the password is not specified, the server generates an initial password and returns it in the initialPassword field of the response
CreateUser.description_zh: 在指定工作空间内创建用户。用户名称在工作空间内唯一，只能包含小写字母、数字和连字符，并且不能使用 manager、admin 或以 worker- 开头的保留名称。不指定 password 时由服务端生成初始密码，并通过响应中的 initialPassword 返回

CreateWorkspace.description_en: Creates an AgentCore workspace as a resource scope to organize agents, models, MCP services, and collaboration configurations
CreateWorkspace.description_zh: 创建 AgentCore 工作空间，作为组织 Agent、模型、MCP 服务和协作配置的资源范围

DebugModel.description_en: Invokes a specified model through a published model connection to verify whether the model invocation pipeline is available
DebugModel.description_zh: 通过已发布的模型连接调用指定模型，用于验证模型调用链路是否可用

DeleteAgentIMChannel.description_en: Deletes the IM channel of a specified agent
DeleteAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 删除指定智能体的 IM 渠道

DeleteAgentSpec.description_en: Deletes the specified AgentSpec and all its versions and metadata. The deletion operation is irreversible
DeleteAgentSpec.description_zh: 删除指定 AgentSpec 及其全部版本和元数据。删除操作不可恢复

DeleteAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Deletes the draft version of the specified AgentSpec that is currently being edited and clears the draft version pointer
DeleteAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 删除指定 AgentSpec 当前正在编辑的草稿版本，并清除草稿版本指针

DeleteAsset.description_en: Writes a deletion tombstone for an asset and initiates asynchronous cleanup. The server authenticates the request, verifies tenant and resource ownership, and checks for existing DELETING or DELETED tombstones. Duplicate requests for assets already in the deletion process return the current status without retriggering the deletion. For undeleted assets that are eligible for deletion, the control plane conditionally writes a tombstone. The operation returns the registered processing status, which does not indicate that the physical data cleanup is complete
DeleteAsset.description_zh: 为资产写入删除墓碑并受理异步清理。服务端先鉴权并校验租户及资源归属，再识别 DELETING 或 DELETED 墓碑；已进入删除的重复请求直接返回当前状态，不重复触发删除。对尚未删除且允许删除的资产，管控层条件写入墓碑。返回已登记的处理状态，不表示物理数据已经清理完成

DeleteCredential.description_en: Deletes a specified credential in a workspace and the ciphertext hosted in the credential service. After the deletion, agents bound to the credential can no longer obtain the credential content
DeleteCredential.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间内的凭证，同时删除托管在凭证服务中的密文。删除后已绑定该凭证的智能体将无法再获取凭证内容

DeleteCustomAgent.description_en: Deletes a custom code or image agent in a specified workspace and asynchronously cleans up its associated platform resources
DeleteCustomAgent.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent，并异步清理其平台关联资源

DeleteEvents.description_en: Deletes events written by a specified session in batches, supporting 1 to 100 event IDs per batch. Returns the deletion result for each event. Events inherited from a parent session cannot be deleted in a child session. Deleting events does not delete extracted memories
DeleteEvents.description_zh: 批量删除指定会话自身写入的事件，每批支持 1～100 个事件标识。逐条返回删除结果；不能在子会话中删除从父会话继承的事件。删除事件不会删除已提取的记忆

DeleteExternalAgent.description_en: Deletes a managed agent from a specified workspace and asynchronously cleans up its associated platform resources
DeleteExternalAgent.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的纳管 Agent，并异步清理其平台关联资源

DeleteIdentityProvider.description_en: Disconnects the identity source integration for a workspace. For CustomSSO, this operation clears the shared user pool and related SAML and SCIM resources. To disable only logon or synchronization, use the corresponding API operations
DeleteIdentityProvider.description_zh: 整体断开工作空间的身份源集成。CustomSSO 会清理共享用户池及相关 SAML、SCIM 资源；只关闭登录或同步时应使用对应开关接口

DeleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredential.description_en: Revokes a specified SCIM credential. This operation does not trigger automatic creation of a new token, modify the access configuration synchronization switch, or disable SAML logon
DeleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredential.description_zh: 撤销指定 SCIM 凭据。不会自动创建新 Token、修改 AC 同步开关或关闭 SAML 登录

DeleteImageCache.description_en: Deletes the image cache association in a workspace and checks agent references and instance usage before submission
DeleteImageCache.description_zh: 删除工作空间中的镜像缓存关联，提交前检查 Agent 引用和实例占用

DeleteKnowledgeBase.description_en: Asynchronously deletes a knowledge base. Verifies the trusted tenant identity, workspace ownership, and access permissions for the knowledge base. If the resource is already in the Deleting or Deleted state, repeated deletion requests return the current state without re-initiating cleanup. After the deletion is accepted, GetKnowledgeBase indicates that the resource does not exist, and ListKnowledgeBases no longer displays the resource. The system continues to clean up physical data in the background
DeleteKnowledgeBase.description_zh: 异步删除知识库。先校验可信租户身份、工作空间归属及知识库访问权限；若资源已为 Deleting 或 Deleted，重复删除返回当前状态，不重复发起清理。删除受理后，GetKnowledgeBase 返回资源不存在，ListKnowledgeBases 不再显示该资源；后台继续清理物理数据

DeleteManagedAgent.description_en: Deletes a managed Harness agent in a specified workspace and asynchronously cleans up its platform-associated resources
DeleteManagedAgent.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的托管 Harness Agent，并异步清理其平台关联资源

DeleteMcp.description_en: Deletes a specified MCP service. The deletion is an asynchronous process. After the process is complete, the MCP service is no longer returned
DeleteMcp.description_zh: 删除指定 MCP 服务。删除为异步过程，完成后该 MCP 服务将不再返回

DeleteMemory.description_en: Deletes a long-term memory based on the memory ID
DeleteMemory.description_zh: 根据 Memory ID 删除一条长期记忆

DeleteMemoryRule.description_en: Deletes a specified memory rule. Subsequent new content is no longer extracted by using this rule. Existing memories are retained. Repeatedly deleting the same rule returns a success response
DeleteMemoryRule.description_zh: 删除指定记忆规则，后续新增内容不再使用该规则抽取。已经生成的记忆保留；重复删除同一规则返回成功

DeleteMemorySession.description_en: Deletes a session and its queryable event history within a specified association scope. If you write to the same association scope and session ID again, a new session is created. You cannot query the historical content of the deleted session. Extracted memories are retained after the session is deleted
DeleteMemorySession.description_zh: 删除指定关联范围中的会话及其可查询事件历史。再次以相同关联范围和 sessionId 写入时创建新的会话，不能查询到已删除会话的历史内容。已经提取的记忆不随会话删除

DeleteMemoryStore.description_en: Asynchronously deletes a MemoryStore and all long-term memory within it
DeleteMemoryStore.description_zh: 异步删除 MemoryStore 及其中全部长期记忆

DeleteModel.description_en: Deletes a model in a specified workspace. Models that are in use cannot be deleted
DeleteModel.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的模型；正在被使用的模型不能删除

DeleteModelConnection.description_en: Submits an asynchronous deletion task for a specified model connection. The connection cannot be deleted if it has associated models or runtime references
DeleteModelConnection.description_zh: 提交指定模型连接的异步删除任务；存在关联模型或运行时引用时不能删除

DeleteSkill.description_en: Deletes a skill and its related version data from the specified workspace. This operation is irreversible
DeleteSkill.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的 Skill 及其相关版本数据。删除操作不可恢复

DeleteSkillDraft.description_en: Deletes the draft version of the specified skill that is currently being edited
DeleteSkillDraft.description_zh: 删除指定 Skill 当前正在编辑的草稿版本

DeleteTeam.description_en: Deletes a team in a specified workspace. Deleting a team does not delete the users and agents within it, but only dissociates the members
DeleteTeam.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间内的团队。删除团队不会删除其中的用户和智能体，只解除成员关系

DeleteUser.description_en: Deletes a user from a specified workspace. A user cannot be deleted if they are still a member of any team. Remove the user from the team first
DeleteUser.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间内的用户。用户仍然是任意团队的成员时不允许删除，需要先将其从团队中移除

DeleteWorkspace.description_en: Deletes a workspace that is no longer in use and ends the management lifecycle of the workspace
DeleteWorkspace.description_zh: 删除不再使用的工作空间，结束该工作空间的管理生命周期

DisableConnector.description_en: Disables the QoderCLI connector in a specified workspace. The connector can be disabled only if no agents are using it. After the connector is disabled, the connector and its service account key configuration are removed
DisableConnector.description_zh: 停用指定工作空间中的 QoderCLI Connector。仅当没有 Agent 使用该 Connector 时可以停用；停用后移除 Connector 及其 Service Account Key 配置

DownloadAgentSpecViaOss.description_en: Retrieves the OSS presigned download URL for a specified AgentSpec to download the AgentSpec ZIP package
DownloadAgentSpecViaOss.description_zh: 获取指定 AgentSpec 的 OSS 预签名下载地址，用于下载 AgentSpec ZIP 包

DownloadSkillVersionViaOss.description_en: Retrieves the OSS pre-signed download URL for a specified skill version to download the corresponding skill ZIP package
DownloadSkillVersionViaOss.description_zh: 获取指定 Skill 版本的 OSS 预签名下载地址，用于下载对应的 Skill ZIP 包

EnableConnector.description_en: Enables the QoderCLI connector in a specified workspace. The request must provide a site, an API key, and at least one service account key. The service verifies all account keys before saving the configuration
EnableConnector.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中启用 QoderCLI Connector。请求需提供站点、API Key 和至少一个 Service Account Key；服务会先验证所有账号密钥，再保存配置

FindCustomAgentImagePreparation.description_en: Retrieves a custom image preparation task by using a submitted client token and queries the current progress
FindCustomAgentImagePreparation.description_zh: 使用已提交的 clientToken 找回自定义镜像准备任务并查询当前进度

ForcePublishSkillVersion.description_en: Forcibly publishes the specified skill version by bypassing the standard review process
ForcePublishSkillVersion.description_zh: 跳过常规审核流程，强制发布指定的 Skill 版本

GetAgentCodePackageDownloadUrl.description_en: Retrieves the time-limited read-only download URL for the currently saved fixed code package of a custom code or image agent
GetAgentCodePackageDownloadUrl.description_zh: 获取自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent当前已保存固定代码包的限时只读下载地址

GetAgentCodePackageOssRamAuthorizeUrl.description_en: Generates a RAM authorization URL for a specified code package source bucket for the workspace resource role
GetAgentCodePackageOssRamAuthorizeUrl.description_zh: 为工作空间资源角色生成指定代码包源 Bucket 的 RAM 授权链接

GetAgentCodePackageUploadUrl.description_en: Generates a time-limited upload URL for a local code package and returns the upload method, request headers, and the sourceUri for subsequent deployment
GetAgentCodePackageUploadUrl.description_zh: 为本地代码包生成限时上传地址，返回上传方法、请求头及后续部署使用的 sourceUri

GetAgentIMChannel.description_en: Queries the details of a specified agent IM channel
GetAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 查询指定智能体 IM 渠道的详细信息

GetAgentSpec.description_en: Queries the governance details of a specified AgentSpec, including basic information, governance pointers, and summaries of all versions
GetAgentSpec.description_zh: 查询指定 AgentSpec 的治理详情，包括基础信息、治理指针和全部版本摘要

GetAgentSpecImportFileUrl.description_en: Retrieves the OSS presigned upload URL and object name required to import an AgentSpec ZIP package. After the upload is complete, you can call the AgentSpec OSS upload API operation to complete the import
GetAgentSpecImportFileUrl.description_zh: 获取导入 AgentSpec ZIP 包所需的 OSS 预签名上传地址和对象名称。上传完成后，可调用 AgentSpec OSS 上传接口完成导入

GetAgentSpecLatest.description_en: Queries the full content of the latest version of a specified AgentSpec for editing or viewing the latest version
GetAgentSpecLatest.description_zh: 查询指定 AgentSpec 的最新版本完整内容，用于编辑或查看 latest 版本

GetAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Queries the complete content of a specified AgentSpec version, including the manifest content, resource files, and metadata
GetAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 查询指定 AgentSpec 版本的完整内容，包括 manifest 内容、资源文件和元数据

GetAgentVersion.description_en: Queries the details of an agent version

GetAsset.description_en: Queries the asset management properties and current processing status. For upload, rebuild, and chunk content editing operations, poll the status of this API until it returns COMPLETED or FAILED. For failure causes, refer to lastError. The publishedResultAvailable field indicates whether the published result is still available. This API does not accept clientToken and does not return receipts for chunkUpdate or historical modifications. If a deletion request is accepted, the API returns a resource not found error
GetAsset.description_zh: 查询资产管理属性及当前处理状态。上传、重建、Chunk 正文编辑均轮询本接口的 status，直到 COMPLETED 或 FAILED，失败原因见 lastError；publishedResultAvailable 表示已发布结果是否仍可用。不接收 clientToken，不返回 chunkUpdate 或某次历史修改的回执；删除受理后返回资源不存在

GetAssetDownloadUrl.description_en: Returns a time-limited download URL for the published original file of an asset, using a unified OSS public endpoint. Returns a status conflict if the asset is not published during initial processing. The published original file remains downloadable during re-chunking or editing, subject to validation of current permissions, enabled status, and deletion status
GetAssetDownloadUrl.description_zh: 返回资产已发布 original 原件的限时下载地址，统一使用 OSS 公网地址。首次处理未发布时返回状态冲突；重新分块或编辑期间仍可下载已发布原件，须通过当前权限、启用及删除状态校验

GetChunk.description_en: Queries a chunk in the currently published generation based on its 1-based logical sequence number within the asset, and verifies the ownership relationship between the chunk and the asset
GetChunk.description_zh: 按资产内从 1 开始的逻辑切片序号查询当前已发布代次中的 Chunk，并校验 Chunk 与资产的归属关系

GetCredential.description_en: Queries the details of a specified credential and returns a list of agents bound to the credential. The credential content is returned in a masked format
GetCredential.description_zh: 查询指定凭证的详细信息，并返回已绑定该凭证的智能体列表。凭证内容以脱敏形式返回

GetCustomAgent.description_en: Queries the latest deployment configuration, version processing results, code package or image information, and running instance status of a custom code or image agent
GetCustomAgent.description_zh: 查询自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent的最新部署配置、版本处理结果、代码包或镜像信息及运行实例状态

GetCustomAgentImagePreparation.description_en: Queries the preparation and deployment progress of the current submission for a custom image by preparation task ID
GetCustomAgentImagePreparation.description_zh: 通过准备任务 ID 查询自定义镜像本次提交的准备与部署进度

GetExternalAgent.description_en: Queries the configuration, model source, version processing status, and external runtime status of a managed agent
GetExternalAgent.description_zh: 查询纳管 Agent的配置、模型来源、版本处理状态及外部运行状态

GetExternalAgentBootstrapOptions.description_en: Queries the available internal and public network access options for a managed agent
GetExternalAgentBootstrapOptions.description_zh: 查询纳管 Agent当前可用的内网、公网接入选项

GetIdentityProvider.description_en: Queries the binding and expected configuration of a specified identity provider. When SAML is configured for CustomSSO, this operation reads back the actual upstream SSO configuration. The SCIM status is queried through a separate API operation
GetIdentityProvider.description_zh: 查询指定身份源的绑定和期望配置。CustomSSO 已配置 SAML 时回读上游实际 SSO 配置，SCIM 状态通过独立接口查询

GetIdentityProviderSCIM.description_en: Queries the actual SCIM receiving configuration, the expected AgentCore synchronization switch, and the status of the most recent independent SCIM task. SAML configuration is not required in advance
GetIdentityProviderSCIM.description_zh: 查询 SCIM 实际接收配置、AC 同步期望开关和最近一次独立 SCIM 任务状态。无需先配置 SAML

GetIdentityProviderServiceProvider.description_en: Queries the SAML service provider (SP) information for CustomSSO, including the Entity ID, ACS URL, and SP metadata XML, to help users configure an external IdP
GetIdentityProviderServiceProvider.description_zh: 查询 CustomSSO 的 SAML SP 信息，包括 Entity ID、ACS URL 和 SP Metadata XML，供用户配置外部 IdP

GetIdentityProviderSyncJob.description_en: Queries an identity provider synchronization task

GetIdentityProviderSyncScope.description_en: Queries the synchronization scope of an identity provider

GetImageCache.description_en: Queries the status, digest, size, and deletion conditions of an image cache in a specified workspace
GetImageCache.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间中镜像缓存的状态、摘要、大小及删除条件

GetKnowledgeBase.description_en: Queries the public information, configuration, and current lifecycle status of a knowledge base in a specified workspace of the current tenant. The status and lastError fields indicate the creation and deletion progress and failure causes
GetKnowledgeBase.description_zh: 查询当前租户指定工作空间中知识库的公开信息、配置和当前生命周期状态；通过 status 和 lastError 获取创建、删除进度及失败原因

GetManagedAgent.description_en: Queries the latest configuration, Harness, skill versions, configuration processing status, and running instance statistics of a managed Harness agent
GetManagedAgent.description_zh: 查询托管 Harness Agent的最新配置、Harness、技能版本、配置处理状态和运行实例统计

GetMcp.description_en: Queries the details of a specified MCP service, such as the address, type, status, authentication configuration, and protocol
GetMcp.description_zh: 查询指定 MCP 服务的地址、类型、状态、认证配置和协议等详情

GetMcpCodePackageUploadUrl.description_en: Returns a time-limited presigned upload URL and a temporary code package token. After the upload is complete, the token can be directly used to create or update a code deployment
GetMcpCodePackageUploadUrl.description_zh: 返回限时预签名上传地址和临时代码包令牌；上传完成后，该令牌可直接用于创建或更新代码部署

GetMcpMarketItem.description_en: Queries the details of an MCP marketplace template
GetMcpMarketItem.description_zh: 查询 MCP 市场模板详情

GetMemory.description_en: Queries the content, associated scope, metadata, source, type, and validity status based on the memory ID
GetMemory.description_zh: 根据记忆标识查询正文、关联范围、元数据、来源、类型及有效状态

GetMemoryRule.description_en: Queries the configuration and task statistics of a specified memory rule, including the number of tasks and the latest execution status
GetMemoryRule.description_zh: 查询指定记忆规则的配置及其任务统计，包括任务数量和最近一次执行情况

GetMemoryStore.description_en: Queries the public information and current status of a MemoryStore in a specified workspace
GetMemoryStore.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间中 MemoryStore 的公开信息和当前状态

GetMemoryTask.description_en: Queries the status, input, execute results, and error message of a memory extraction node. A successful node may not generate new memories. If a fault occurs, check the error field for the cause
GetMemoryTask.description_zh: 查询记忆抽取任务的状态、输入、执行结果和错误信息。任务成功时可能没有产生新记忆；发生错误时可查看 error 获取原因

GetModel.description_en: Queries the detailed configuration and region of a model in a specified workspace
GetModel.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间中模型的详细配置和所属地域

GetModelConnection.description_en: Queries the detailed configuration, credential configuration status, publish status, and region of a specified model connection
GetModelConnection.description_zh: 查询指定模型连接的详细配置、凭据配置状态、发布状态和所属地域

GetSandboxRebuildOperation.description_en: Queries the overall result of a specified sandbox rebuild task. Always use the initial operationId returned by RebuildSandbox, without tracking the rebuild task and subsequent creation tasks separately. Only a status of SUCCEEDED indicates completion. UNKNOWN, missing status, or query exceptions must not be treated as success, and the rebuild must not be automatically resubmitted
GetSandboxRebuildOperation.description_zh: 查询指定 Sandbox 重建任务的整体结果。始终使用 RebuildSandbox 返回的首次 operationId，无需分别跟踪重建任务和后续创建任务。只有 status 为 SUCCEEDED 才表示完成；UNKNOWN、状态缺失或查询异常不能按成功处理，也不要自动重新提交重建

GetServiceEndpoint.description_en: Queries the details of a specified service endpoint, including the target route, access address, authentication configuration, and current status
GetServiceEndpoint.description_zh: 查询指定服务端点的详细信息，包括目标路由、访问地址、鉴权配置和当前状态

GetServiceEndpointApiKey.description_en: Queries the currently effective API key and its invocation method for a service endpoint in a specified workspace
GetServiceEndpointApiKey.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间内服务端点当前生效的 API Key 及其调用方式

GetSkillDetail.description_en: Queries the basic information, version status, tags, visibility scope, and version list of a specified skill
GetSkillDetail.description_zh: 查询指定 Skill 的基础信息、版本状态、标签、可见范围和版本列表

GetSkillImportFileUrl.description_en: Retrieves the OSS presigned upload URL and object name required to import a skill ZIP package. After the upload is complete, call the skill OSS upload API to complete the import
GetSkillImportFileUrl.description_zh: 获取导入 Skill ZIP 包所需的 OSS 预签名上传地址和对象名称。上传完成后，可调用 Skill OSS 上传接口完成导入

GetSkillVersionDetail.description_en: Queries the complete details of a specified skill version, including version metadata, skill content, and associated resources
GetSkillVersionDetail.description_zh: 查询指定 Skill 版本的完整详情，包括版本元数据、Skill 内容和关联资源

GetTeam.description_en: Queries the details of a specified team. The response also returns the complete attributes and team roles of each user and agent member in the team
GetTeam.description_zh: 查询指定团队的详细信息，响应中同时返回团队内每个用户成员和智能体成员的完整属性及其团队角色

GetUser.description_en: Queries the details of a specific user in a specified workspace. Returns an error if the user does not exist
GetUser.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间内某个用户的详细信息。用户不存在时返回错误

GetWorkspace.description_en: Queries the details of a workspace by workspace ID, including the lifecycle status, CMS workspace, AI Registry namespace, and current network policies
GetWorkspace.description_zh: 根据工作空间 ID 查询工作空间详情，包括生命周期状态、CMS Workspace、AIRegistry Namespace 和当前网络策略

GetWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorizeUrl.description_en: Generates a RAM authorization link for a workspace resource role to pull images from a specified ACR Enterprise Edition repository
GetWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorizeUrl.description_zh: 生成工作空间资源角色对指定 ACR 企业版仓库的 RAM 拉取授权链接

GetWorkspaceAgenticFsMountRamAuthorizeUr.description_en: Retrieves the RAM page URL to authorize the workspace resource role to access a specified AgenticFS access point before configuring NAS storage mounting for an agent
GetWorkspaceAgenticFsMountRamAuthorizeUr.description_zh: 为 Agent 配置 NAS 存储挂载前，获取授权工作空间资源角色访问指定 AgenticFS 接入点的 RAM 页面地址

GetWorkspacePlugin.description_en: Queries the activation status and configuration of a specified component in a workspace. The collaboration value corresponds to the Collaboration component displayed in the console
GetWorkspacePlugin.description_zh: 查询工作空间指定组件的开通状态和配置；collaboration 对应控制台展示的“协作组件”

InstallMcpMarketItem.description_zh: 安装 MCP 市场模板

InstallWorkspacePlugin.description_en: Enables a component for a workspace, which corresponds to the operation of enabling the collaboration component in the console. After the component is enabled, you can query its status and current configurations
InstallWorkspacePlugin.description_zh: 为工作空间开通组件，对应控制台的协作组件开通操作；开通后可查询组件状态和当前配置

ListAgentCodeRuntimes.description_en: Queries the identity, name, and architecture of language runtime environments currently available for code package deployment
ListAgentCodeRuntimes.description_zh: 分页查询当前可用于代码包部署的语言运行环境标识、名称和架构

ListAgentIMChannels.description_en: Queries the IM channels of a specified agent
ListAgentIMChannels.description_zh: 查询指定智能体的 IM 渠道列表

ListAgentSpecs.description_en: Performs a paging query for AgentSpecs in a specified workspace, and supports name search, sorting, and filtering by owner, visibility scope, and business labels
ListAgentSpecs.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 AgentSpec，支持名称搜索、排序以及按所有者、可见范围和业务标签筛选

ListAgentTeams.description_en: Queries the teams to which specified agents belong. Specify the agent IDs to query by using agentIds. The operation returns the membership information of each agent in its teams, including the team ID, team name, and the role of the agent in the team
ListAgentTeams.description_zh: 查询指定智能体所属的团队列表。通过 agentIds 指定需要查询的智能体 ID，返回每个智能体与团队的成员关系信息，包括团队 ID、团队名称和智能体在团队中承担的角色

ListAgentVersions.description_en: Queries the list of agent versions

ListAssets.description_en: Performs a paged query for undeleted assets in a knowledge base based on the file name prefix and processing status. The results are sorted in descending order by the most recent upload time, and then by assetId in descending order for identical upload times. The upload time refers to the acceptance time of the most recent BeginAssetUpload request. It is updated upon overwrite uploads but remains unchanged for replays with the same token or when you deduplicate the source. It does not represent the processing time. The list index is updated asynchronously and may experience brief delays. The totalCount is cached for 60 seconds based on the resource scope and filter conditions, which may result in brief staleness. Stop paging only when nextToken is empty. If the legacy table lacks the upload time column or sorting index, a ServiceUnavailable error is returned. In this case, use a newly created knowledge base
ListAssets.description_zh: 按文件名前缀和处理状态分页查询知识库内未删除的资产，按最近上传时间倒序，同一时间按 assetId 倒序。上传时间取最近一次新上传的 BeginAssetUpload 受理时间，覆盖上传会更新，同 token 重放或来源去重复用不变；不是处理时间。列表索引异步更新，可能有短暂延迟。totalCount 按资源作用域和筛选条件缓存 60 秒，可能短暂陈旧；翻页终止只以 nextToken 为空为准。旧表缺少上传时间列或排序索引时返回 ServiceUnavailable，需使用新建知识库

ListChunks.description_en: Performs a paged query for currently published chunks in a knowledge base. Results can be filtered by asset, keyword, and enabled status. If an assetId is specified, results are sorted by chunkSeq, and the nextToken is attached to the current publish result of the asset. A VersionConflict (409) error is returned if the publish result changes. If no assetId is specified, results are sorted by assetId and chunkSeq, and a full-base snapshot is not guaranteed. The token is always attached to the tenant, workspace, knowledge base, filter conditions, and sorting
ListChunks.description_zh: 分页查询知识库中当前已发布的 Chunk，可按资产、关键词和启用状态过滤。指定 assetId 时按 chunkSeq 排序，nextToken 绑定该资产的当前发布结果，发布结果变化返回 VersionConflict（409）。未指定 assetId 时按 assetId、chunkSeq 排序，不承诺全库快照。令牌始终绑定租户、工作空间、知识库、过滤条件和排序

ListConnectorModels.description_en: Queries the official and enterprise models available for the enabled QoderCLI connector. The service retrieves models in real time by using the saved API key and organization ID, and deduplicates them by model ID
ListConnectorModels.description_zh: 查询已启用 QoderCLI Connector 可用的官方模型和企业模型。服务使用已保存的 API Key 和组织 ID 实时获取模型，并按模型 ID 去重

ListConnectors.description_en: Queries the list of connectors supported by a specified workspace, along with their status, number of bound agents, and configurations. The current version returns the QoderCLI connector
ListConnectors.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间支持的 Connector 列表及其状态、已绑定 Agent 数量和配置。当前版本返回 QoderCLI Connector

ListCredentials.description_en: Queries credentials in a specified workspace with paging. Filters credentials by type using credentialType, performs fuzzy matching on credential names using nameLike, specifies the maximum number of records per page using maxResults, and retrieves the next page using nextToken. If maxResults is not specified, the server returns 10 records by default
ListCredentials.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的凭证。通过 credentialType 按类型过滤，通过 nameLike 按凭证名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条

ListCustomAgents.description_en: Performs a paging query for the identifiers, deployment methods, and status summaries of custom code or image agents in a workspace
ListCustomAgents.description_zh: 分页查询工作空间内自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent的标识、部署方式和状态摘要

ListEvents.description_en: Performs a paged query on the events of a specified session in chronological order from oldest to newest, including the parent session history referenced when a session branch is created. The sessionId parameter is required, and other scope dimensions must match those used during write operations. Write or delete operations during paging may affect the results of subsequent pages
ListEvents.description_zh: 按事件发生时间从旧到新分页查询指定会话的事件，包括创建会话分支时引用的父会话历史。必须提供 sessionId，其余范围维度需与写入时一致。分页期间写入或删除事件可能影响后续页的结果

ListExternalAgents.description_en: Performs a paging query for the identity, configuration version, and status summary of managed agents in a workspace
ListExternalAgents.description_zh: 分页查询工作空间内纳管 Agent的标识、配置版本和状态摘要

ListIdentityProviderDepartments.description_en: Performs a paged query on the departments of an identity provider by using paging

ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials.description_en: Queries the complete summary list of up to two SCIM credentials in a shared user pool. Plaintext tokens are not returned, and pagination is not supported
ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials.description_zh: 查询共享用户池中最多两枚 SCIM 凭据的完整摘要列表，不返回 Token 明文，不提供分页

ListIdentityProviders.description_en: Queries the summary of existing identity provider bindings for a workspace, including CustomSSO. Returns local binding information without querying the actual upstream SAML or SCIM configurations
ListIdentityProviders.description_zh: 查询工作空间已有的身份源绑定摘要，包括 CustomSSO。返回本地绑定信息，不回查上游 SAML 或 SCIM 实际配置

ListImageCaches.description_en: Performs a paged query on image caches in a workspace, and supports paging and filtering by image source and cache status
ListImageCaches.description_zh: 分页查询工作空间的镜像缓存，支持按镜像来源和缓存状态筛选

ListKnowledgeBases.description_en: Queries knowledge bases in a specified workspace of the current tenant by using paging. Each returned item includes the status and lastError fields, which can be used to query the creation and deletion progress of knowledge bases and the causes of failures
ListKnowledgeBases.description_zh: 分页查询当前租户指定工作空间中的知识库；每项返回 status 和 lastError，可用于查询知识库创建、删除进度及失败原因

ListManagedAgents.description_en: Performs a paging query to retrieve the identity, harness, configuration version, and status summary of managed Harness agents in a workspace
ListManagedAgents.description_zh: 分页查询工作空间内托管 Harness Agent的标识、Harness、配置版本和状态摘要

ListMcpMarketItems.description_zh: 查询 MCP 市场模板

ListMcpTools.description_en: Queries the list of tools exposed by a specified MCP service and their input and output schemas
ListMcpTools.description_zh: 查询指定 MCP 服务公开的工具列表及其输入输出 Schema

ListMcps.description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the MCP services, configurations, and statuses in a specified workspace by using paging
ListMcps.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 MCP 服务及其配置和状态

ListMemories.description_en: Performs a paged query on memories in a memory store. Supports paging and filtering by associate scope, content type, source, validity status, and update time. Unspecified scope dimensions are excluded from filtering. If valid is omitted, only valid memories are returned. If valid is set to false, revoked memories are returned
ListMemories.description_zh: 分页查询记忆库中的记忆，可按关联范围、内容类型、来源、有效状态和更新时间筛选。未指定的范围维度不参与筛选。valid 省略时仅返回有效记忆，false 返回已撤销的记忆

ListMemoryRules.description_en: Performs a paged query of the extraction rules in a memory store. Supports paging, filtering by name and enabled status, and returns the rule configurations
ListMemoryRules.description_zh: 分页查询记忆库中的抽取规则。支持按名称和启用状态筛选，返回规则配置

ListMemorySessionMessages.description_en: Performs a paging query for raw messages by exact scope. SessionId is required, and at least one of UserId or AgentId must be provided
ListMemorySessionMessages.description_zh: 按精确 Scope 分页查询原始消息。SessionId 必填，UserId 和 AgentId 至少提供一个

ListMemorySessions.description_en: Performs a paging query of sessions in a memory store. You can filter the sessions by user, team, or agent. Unspecified dimensions are not used for filtering
ListMemorySessions.description_zh: 分页查询记忆库中的会话，可按用户、团队或智能体筛选。未指定的维度不参与筛选

ListMemoryStores.description_en: Queries MemoryStores in a specified workspace by using paging
ListMemoryStores.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 MemoryStore

ListMemoryTasks.description_en: Performs a paged query for memory extraction nodes of a specified rule. The ruleId parameter is required. You can further filter the nodes by status. If the specified rule does not exist or is deleted, a success response with an empty list is returned. Paging is supported
ListMemoryTasks.description_zh: 分页查询指定规则的记忆抽取任务。ruleId 必填，可进一步按任务状态筛选。指定规则不存在或已删除时返回成功及空列表

ListModelConnections.description_en: Queries model connections in a specified workspace by using paging, and supports filtering by name, provider type, and invocation protocol
ListModelConnections.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的模型连接，支持按名称、供应商类型和调用协议筛选

ListModels.description_en: Performs a paged query for models in a specified workspace and supports filtering by model connection and model name during paging
ListModels.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的模型，支持按模型连接和模型名称筛选

ListPredefinedModelProviders.description_en: Queries the providers supported by the AgentCore built-in model catalog and their default service configurations
ListPredefinedModelProviders.description_zh: 查询 AgentCore 内置模型目录支持的供应商及其默认服务配置

ListPredefinedModels.description_en: Queries the models and their capabilities in the built-in model catalog of AgentCore for a specified provider
ListPredefinedModels.description_zh: 查询指定供应商在 AgentCore 内置模型目录中的模型及其能力信息

ListSandboxSessions.description_en: Performs a paging query to retrieve the current active sessions and their sources in a specified agent instance
ListSandboxSessions.description_zh: 分页查询指定智能体实例中的当前活动会话及其来源

ListSandboxes.description_en: Performs a paging query on the running instances of an agent and supports filtering by sandbox ID and current valid session ID fragments
ListSandboxes.description_zh: 分页查询智能体的运行实例，支持按 Sandbox ID 和当前有效 Session ID 片段筛选

ListServiceEndpoints.description_en: Performs a paging query of service endpoints in a specified workspace and supports filtering by target type, agent, collaboration component, and status
ListServiceEndpoints.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的服务端点，支持按目标类型、智能体、协作组件和状态过滤

ListSkillReferences.description_en: Queries the reference relationships of a skill
ListSkillReferences.description_zh: 查询 Skill 引用关系

ListSkills.description_en: Performs a paged query for skills in a specified workspace and returns the basic information, version status, and paging information of the skills
ListSkills.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 Skill，返回 Skill 基础信息、版本状态和分页信息

ListTeams.description_en: Queries teams in a specified workspace with paging. You can use nameLike to filter teams by fuzzy match on the team name, maxResults to specify the maximum number of records per page, and nextToken to obtain the next page. If maxResults is not specified, the server returns 10 records by default. The member information in the list includes only the member identifier, name, and team role
ListTeams.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的团队。通过 nameLike 按团队名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条。列表中的成员信息只包含成员标识、名称和团队角色

ListUsers.description_en: Performs a paged query for users in a specified workspace. You can use nameLike to filter users by fuzzy match on the username, maxResults to specify the maximum number of records per page, and nextToken to retrieve the next page during paging. If maxResults is not specified, the server returns 10 records by default
ListUsers.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的用户。通过 nameLike 按用户名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条

ListWorkspaces.description_en: Performs a paged query of workspaces under the current tenant. By default, the list does not return soft-deleted records with the Deleted status, and the server performs stable sorting of the results by creation order during paging
ListWorkspaces.description_zh: 分页查询当前租户下的工作空间。列表默认不返回状态为 Deleted 的软删除记录，结果按创建顺序由服务端稳定排序

OfflineSkill.description_en: Takes the online version of a specified skill offline so that it is no longer used as the online version
OfflineSkill.description_zh: 将指定 Skill 的在线版本下线，使其不再作为在线版本使用

OnlineSkill.description_en: Sets the specified skill version as the online version
OnlineSkill.description_zh: 将指定 Skill 版本设置为在线版本

PrecheckSkillUploadViaOss.description_en: Parses and checks one or more skill ZIP packages uploaded to OSS, and returns the names, versions, and conflict check results
PrecheckSkillUploadViaOss.description_zh: 解析并检查已上传到 OSS 的一个或多个 Skill ZIP 包，返回名称、版本和冲突检查结果

PrepareIdentityProviderSCIM.description_en: Prepares the SCIM receiving configuration and returns the provisioning URL and credential summary. Issues a token if no available credentials exist and returns the plaintext only in the current response without automatically enabling user synchronization in AgentCore
PrepareIdentityProviderSCIM.description_zh: 准备 SCIM 接收配置，返回预配 URL 和凭据摘要；没有可用凭据时签发 Token，仅本次返回明文，不自动开启 AC 用户同步

PublishSkillVersion.description_en: Publishes a specified skill version and sets its status to published
PublishSkillVersion.description_zh: 发布指定的 Skill 版本，使其进入已发布状态

RebuildSandbox.description_en: Submits a single sandbox image rebuild for a specified managed agent. Existing sessions may be interrupted. An HTTP 200 response only indicates that the request is accepted. Use the returned operationId to call GetSandboxRebuildOperation to query the overall result. Only a SUCCEEDED status indicates that the rebuild is complete. Do not automatically resubmit the rebuild if the query times out, returns UNKNOWN, or the result is unclear
RebuildSandbox.description_zh: 提交指定托管智能体的单个 Sandbox 镜像重建，已有会话可能中断。HTTP 200 仅表示请求受理，使用返回的 operationId 调用 GetSandboxRebuildOperation 查询整体结果；只有 SUCCEEDED 表示重建完成。查询超时、UNKNOWN 或结果不明时，不要自动重新提交重建

RedraftSkillVersion.description_en: Reverts a specified skill version to an editable draft for further modification
RedraftSkillVersion.description_zh: 将指定 Skill 版本重新转为可编辑草稿，以便继续修改

ResetUserPassword.description_en: Resets the logon password of a specified user. Specify the user by using agentCoreUserId or username. At least one of the two parameters is required. This operation only supports users who use local password authentication in the workspace. If the password parameter is not specified, the server generates a random password and returns it in the response
ResetUserPassword.description_zh: 重置指定用户的登录密码。通过 agentCoreUserId 或 username 指定用户，两者至少指定一个。仅支持重置使用工作空间本地密码认证的用户；不指定 password 时由服务端生成随机密码并在响应中返回

RetryImageCache.description_en: Resubmits the creation request for an ACR image cache in a specified workspace
RetryImageCache.description_zh: 重新提交指定工作空间中 ACR 镜像缓存的制作请求

RetryMemoryTask.description_en: Retries a failed memory task by reusing the original task ID, input, and extraction configuration. Only tasks in the FAILED state support retries. After a retry, you can query the progress by calling GetMemoryTask
RetryMemoryTask.description_zh: 重新执行失败的记忆任务，沿用原任务标识、输入和抽取配置。仅 FAILED 状态支持重试，重试后可通过 GetMemoryTask 查询进度

RevokeMemory.description_en: Invalidates the specified memory while retaining its content. After revocation, the memory no longer participates in retrieval as a valid memory. You can query it by setting valid=false in ListMemories. Repeated revocations return a success response
RevokeMemory.description_zh: 将指定记忆设为无效并保留正文。撤销后，该记忆不再作为有效记忆参与检索；可通过 ListMemories 的 valid=false 查询。重复撤销返回成功

SearchKnowledgeBase.description_en: Executes keyword, vector, or hybrid search on published and authorized results in a specified knowledge base. Search parameters take effect in the order of the current request, knowledge base search configuration, and system default values. Metadata filtering uses a JSON expression tree and does not accept OTS DSL or tenant fields. The actual number of results after filtering and permission verification may be less than topK. The search feature provides eventual consistency, and newly published results become searchable after index synchronization. Reading candidates still verifies the current publish pointer and permissions
SearchKnowledgeBase.description_zh: 在指定知识库的已发布且已授权结果中执行关键词、向量或混合检索。检索参数按本次请求、知识库检索配置、系统默认值的顺序生效。元数据过滤使用 JSON 表达式树，不接受 OTS DSL 或租户字段；过滤和权限校验后实际结果数可能少于 topK。一期检索为最终一致性，新发布结果在索引同步后可检索；读取候选仍校验当前发布指针和权限

SearchMemories.description_en: Retrieves relevant memories based on the query text. Supports filtering by association scope, type, and metadata, and sets result thresholds through similarity and relevance scores. If topK is omitted or set to 0, the default value 10 is used, with a maximum of 200
SearchMemories.description_zh: 根据查询文本检索相关记忆。支持按关联范围、类型和元数据筛选，并通过相似度及相关性得分设置结果下限。topK 省略或为 0 时使用默认值 10，最大为 200

SubmitAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Submits a specified draft version of an AgentSpec for review. If no release pipeline is configured, the version is directly published online
SubmitAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 提交指定 AgentSpec 草稿版本进入审核流程。未配置发布流水线时，版本将直接发布为在线状态

SubmitSkillVersion.description_en: Submits a specified draft version of a skill for review
SubmitSkillVersion.description_zh: 提交指定的 Skill 草稿版本进入审核流程

UpdateAgentIMChannel.description_en: Updates the ServiceEndpoint, enabling status, or channel behavior configuration bound to an IM channel. At least one updatable field must be provided
UpdateAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 更新 IM 渠道绑定的 ServiceEndpoint、启停状态或渠道行为配置。至少需要提供一个可更新字段

UpdateAgentIMChannelCredential.description_en: Updates all channel credentials for a specified IM channel. Secrets are not returned in the response
UpdateAgentIMChannelCredential.description_zh: 全量更新指定 IM 渠道的渠道凭据。Secret 不会在响应中回显

UpdateAgentSpec.description_en: Updates the business tags, version tags, and visibility scope of a specified AgentSpec. Fields not passed remain unchanged
UpdateAgentSpec.description_zh: 更新指定 AgentSpec 的业务标签、版本标签和可见范围；未传入的字段保持不变

UpdateAsset.description_en: Updates the asset name, enabled status, metadata patch, or asset-level chunking configuration. At least one of these items must be provided in the request. Metadata is incrementally merged, and chunkConfiguration triggers asynchronous rechunking. Changes that affect retrieval projections cause the backend to create a new generation and conditionally publish it. Before publication, previously published results remain readable as long as the asset is not disabled, deleted, or unauthorized, and published results are not modified in place. Processing failures in the current phase are not retried. For assets in the FAILED state, only the name or enabled status can be modified. Submitting metadata or chunkConfiguration returns InvalidAssetState
UpdateAsset.description_zh: 更新资产名称、启用状态、元数据补丁或资产级分块配置，请求至少提供其中一项。metadata 增量合并，chunkConfiguration 触发异步重新分块；影响检索投影的变更由后端创建新代次并条件发布。发布前，旧已发布结果在资产未禁用、未删除且授权仍有效时保持可读，不原地修改已发布结果。本期处理失败后不重试，FAILED 资产仅允许修改 name 或 enabled，提交 metadata 或 chunkConfiguration 返回 InvalidAssetState

UpdateChunk.description_en: Updates the content or enabled status of a chunk by its logical sequence number. You must pass back the opaque chunkToken returned by the query operation. When only the enabled status is modified, the system synchronously writes to OTS after reading the currently published result, validating the token, and fixing the target at the beginning of the request. Enabling or disabling is allowed when a published result exists and is not deleted, including the PENDING, PROCESSING, and FAILED states, without waiting for FC. New results published during this process are not followed, rolled back, or appended with post-write version conflicts. New results are not guaranteed to inherit concurrent enable or disable operations. Indexes are synchronized asynchronously, which may cause a brief delay in retrieval. Modifying the content is only allowed when the status is COMPLETED. The system asynchronously computes the target vectors and publishes the complete result. You can call GetAsset to query the current status, lastError, and publishedResultAvailable of the document. Content edits with the same clientToken are idempotently replayed with the original result. An expired token at the beginning of the request returns Chunk.VersionConflict. Execution generations are managed only on the backend
UpdateChunk.description_zh: 按逻辑切片序号更新正文或启用状态，须回传查询返回的不透明 chunkToken。仅修改 enabled 时，Magic 在请求开始读取当前已发布结果、校验令牌并固定目标后同步写 OTS；已有发布结果且未删除时允许启停，包括 PENDING、PROCESSING、FAILED，不等待 FC。期间新结果发布不追随、不回滚，也不追加写后版本冲突；新结果不保证继承并发启停。索引异步同步，检索可能短暂延迟。修改 content 仍仅允许 COMPLETED，异步计算目标向量并发布完整结果，通过 GetAsset 查询文档当前 status、lastError 和 publishedResultAvailable。内容编辑相同 clientToken 幂等重放原结果。请求开始已过期的令牌返回 Chunk.VersionConflict。执行代次只在后端管理

UpdateConnector.description_en: Updates the API key or service account key collection for an enabled QoderCLI connector. When serviceAccountKeys is submitted, the service treats it as the updated complete key collection to perform additions, renames, rotations, and deletions
UpdateConnector.description_zh: 更新已启用 QoderCLI Connector 的 API Key 或 Service Account Key 集合。提交 serviceAccountKeys 时，服务将其作为更新后的完整密钥集合执行新增、重命名、轮换和删除

UpdateCredential.description_en: Updates the content, description, or MCP header application scope of a specified credential. Unspecified configurations retain their original values. The credential name and type cannot be modified
UpdateCredential.description_zh: 更新指定凭证的内容、描述或 MCP Header 适用范围。未指定的配置保留原值，凭证名称和类型不可修改

UpdateCustomAgent.description_en: Updates the configuration of a custom code or image agent in a specified workspace and executes the update asynchronously. Omitted top-level fields retain their original configurations. You can call the GetCustomAgent operation to query the update result
UpdateCustomAgent.description_zh: 更新指定工作空间中的自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent配置，并异步执行更新。省略的顶层字段保留原配置，可通过 GetCustomAgent 查询更新结果

UpdateExternalAgent.description_en: Updates the model source, instructions, tools, and skills of a managed agent, and processes the configuration asynchronously
UpdateExternalAgent.description_zh: 更新纳管 Agent的模型来源、指令、工具和技能，并异步处理配置

UpdateIdentityProvider.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a bound identity provider in a specified workspace. DingTalk and Feishu support login switches, address book synchronization switches, application configurations, and synchronization scopes. CustomSSO supports SAML or OIDC login configurations and login switches. SCIM user synchronization is configured independently. Updates take effect asynchronously. You can query the status by calling GetIdentityProvider
UpdateIdentityProvider.description_zh: 修改指定工作空间已绑定身份源的配置。DingTalk、Feishu 支持登录开关、通讯录同步开关、应用配置和同步范围；CustomSSO 支持 SAML 或 OIDC 登录配置及登录开关。SCIM 用户同步独立配置。更新异步生效，通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询状态

UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM.description_en: Enables or disables SCIM-based user synchronization independently. When enabled, an initial full import is executed asynchronously. You can query the result by calling GetIdentityProviderSCIM. The SAML logon configuration is retained
UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM.description_zh: 独立启用或关闭 SCIM 用户同步。开启时异步执行首次全量导入，结果通过 GetIdentityProviderSCIM 查询，保留 SAML 登录配置

UpdateKnowledgeBase.description_en: Updates the name, description, chunking, or search configuration of a knowledge base. The metadataSchema, embeddingModel, and embeddingDimension cannot be modified after creation. The chunking configuration applies only to subsequently uploaded assets and does not implicitly rebuild existing assets
UpdateKnowledgeBase.description_zh: 更新知识库的名称、描述、分块或检索配置。metadataSchema、embeddingModel 和 embeddingDimension 创建后不可修改。分块配置仅作用于后续上传的资产，不会隐式重建已有资产

UpdateManagedAgent.description_en: Updates the model, instructions, skills, and runtime configuration of a managed Harness agent and executes the update asynchronously. Omitted top-level fields retain their original configuration
UpdateManagedAgent.description_zh: 更新托管 Harness Agent的模型、指令、技能和运行配置，并异步执行更新；省略的顶层字段保留原配置

UpdateMcp.description_en: Updates the address, description, authentication, or Swagger configuration of a specified MCP service. The MCP type and protocol cannot be modified after creation. The update process is asynchronous
UpdateMcp.description_zh: 更新指定 MCP 服务的地址、描述、认证或 Swagger 配置。MCP 类型和协议在创建后不可修改。更新为异步过程

UpdateMcpTemplateConfig.description_en: Updates the MCP parameters based on a template
UpdateMcpTemplateConfig.description_zh: 按模板更新 MCP 参数

UpdateMemory.description_en: Updates the content or metadata of a specified memory. At least one field must be provided for the update, and unprovided fields retain their original values. The metadata is fully replaced. Pass an empty object to clear the metadata
UpdateMemory.description_zh: 更新指定记忆的正文或元数据。至少提供一个更新字段；未提供的字段保持原值。metadata 为完整替换，传入空对象可清空元数据

UpdateMemoryRule.description_en: Updates the name, description, enabling status, or extraction strategy of a memory rule. At least one field to update must be provided. Fields that are not provided remain unchanged
UpdateMemoryRule.description_zh: 更新记忆规则的名称、描述、启用状态或抽取策略。至少提供一个更新字段；未提供的字段保持原值

UpdateModel.description_en: Updates the description, context token limit, maximum output token count, or capability configurations of a specified model
UpdateModel.description_zh: 更新指定模型的描述、上下文 Token 上限、最大输出 Token 数或能力配置

UpdateModelConnection.description_en: Updates the mutable configurations of a specified model connection and resubmits the publishing task. The invocation protocol cannot be modified after creation
UpdateModelConnection.description_zh: 更新指定模型连接的可变配置并重新提交发布任务；调用协议创建后不可修改

UpdateSkillBizTags.description_en: Updates the business tags of a specified skill. Other attributes that are not specified remain unchanged
UpdateSkillBizTags.description_zh: 更新指定 Skill 的业务标签；未传入的其他属性保持不变

UpdateSkillLabels.description_en: Updates the version labels and their mappings for a specified skill
UpdateSkillLabels.description_zh: 更新指定 Skill 的版本标签及其指向关系

UpdateSkillScope.description_en: Updates the visibility scope of a specified skill
UpdateSkillScope.description_zh: 更新指定 Skill 的可见范围

UpdateTeam.description_en: Updates the description and members of a specified team. When users or agents are provided, the corresponding member list is replaced based on full overwrite semantics. Member lists that are not provided remain unchanged. The team name cannot be modified after creation
UpdateTeam.description_zh: 更新指定团队的描述和成员。传入 users 或 agents 时按全量覆盖语义替换对应的成员列表，未传入的成员列表保持不变。团队名称创建后不可修改

UpdateUser.description_en: Updates the display name, email address, or note of a specified user. You must specify at least one of the displayName, email, and note parameters. Unspecified attributes remain unchanged. The username cannot be modified after creation
UpdateUser.description_zh: 更新指定用户的显示名称、邮箱或备注。displayName、email 和 note 至少指定一个，未指定的属性保持不变。用户名称创建后不可修改

UpdateWorkspace.description_en: Updates the name or network configuration of a workspace. Only workspaces in the Initialized state can be updated. The Status, TenantId, and RegionId fields are maintained by the server and cannot be modified through this operation
UpdateWorkspace.description_zh: 更新工作空间名称或网络配置。只有状态为 Initialized 的工作空间允许更新。Status、TenantId 和 RegionId 由服务端维护，不允许通过本接口修改

UploadAgentSpecViaOss.description_en: Retrieves an uploaded AgentSpec ZIP package from OSS, parses it, and imports the AgentSpec into the current workspace
UploadAgentSpecViaOss.description_zh: 从 OSS 获取已上传的 AgentSpec ZIP 包，解析后将 AgentSpec 导入当前工作空间

UploadSkillViaOss.description_en: Imports a skill into the current workspace by retrieving and parsing an uploaded skill ZIP package from OSS
UploadSkillViaOss.description_zh: 从 OSS 获取已上传的 Skill ZIP 包，解析后将 Skill 导入当前工作空间

ValidateAgentCodePackageFromOss.description_en: Validates the read permissions of the workspace role on a specified OSS code package object, and returns the source URI and package information
ValidateAgentCodePackageFromOss.description_zh: 校验工作空间角色对指定 OSS 代码包对象的读取条件，并返回来源地址和包信息

VerifyAgentCodePackageOssRamAuthorizatio.description_en: Queries the binding status of the authorization policy for the code package source bucket to the current workspace resource role
VerifyAgentCodePackageOssRamAuthorizatio.description_zh: 查询代码包源 Bucket 对当前工作空间资源角色的授权策略绑定状态

VerifyConnector.description_en: Validates whether one or more Qoder service account keys are available at a specified site. This operation does not save the keys or modify the connector status
VerifyConnector.description_zh: 验证一个或多个 Qoder Service Account Key 在指定站点是否可用。该操作不保存密钥，也不修改 Connector 状态

VerifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorization.description_en: Queries the authorization status of a workspace resource role for a specified ACR Enterprise Edition repository
VerifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorization.description_zh: 查询工作空间资源角色对指定 ACR 企业版仓库的授权状态

VerifyWorkspaceAgenticFsMountRamAuthoriz.description_en: Queries whether the workspace resource role has been granted access to the target NAS (AgenticFS) access point for subsequent Agent mount configurations
VerifyWorkspaceAgenticFsMountRamAuthoriz.description_zh: 查询工作空间资源角色是否已完成目标 NAS（AgenticFS）接入点的访问授权，供继续配置 Agent 挂载时使用

VerifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorization.description_en: Verifies the OSS mount authorization for a workspace, or checks and updates the authorization status of the default OSS storage for the workspace
VerifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorization.description_zh: 验证工作空间 OSS 挂载授权，或检查并更新工作空间默认 OSS 存储的授权状态
